title: status_only_transition_preserves_outcome_test never runs a status-only transition after an outcome is recorded
evidence:
+pub fn status_only_transition_preserves_outcome_test() {
+  use <- unitest.tag("integration")
+  let db = setup()
+  let app_id = seed_app(db)
+  let call_id = insert_call(db, app_id)
+  let assert Ok(call_uuid) = uuid.from_string(call_id)
+
+  // Drive to a terminal with an outcome…
+  let assert Ok(_) =
+    rc_sql.update_reference_call_status(
+      db,
+      call_uuid,
+      rc_sql.ContactInitiated,
+      "",
+      "",
+      rc_sql.Queued,
+    )
+  let assert Ok(_) =
+    rc_sql.update_reference_call_status(
+      db,
+      call_uuid,
+      rc_sql.FormCompleted,
+      "form_completed",
+      "",
+      rc_sql.ContactInitiated,
+    )
detail: The only ''-outcome transition runs while outcome is still NULL; the later transition passes 'form_completed' explicitly. No status-only transition runs after a recorded outcome, so the COALESCE-preserve property the name claims is never verified.
recommended_fix: After recording the terminal outcome, fire a guarded status-only transition ('' outcome) and assert the stored outcome survives; otherwise rename the test to match what it actually asserts.

title: Guarded update clears next_attempt_at on skip but can never restore it — A6 re-enable-to-queued would leave the row invisible to the sweep
evidence:
+-- Entering any terminal status — or 'skipped', which must leave the cadence
+-- — clears next_attempt_at so the sweep never touches the row again.

+    next_attempt_at = CASE
+      WHEN $2::reference_call_status IN (
+        'skipped', 'partial', 'form_completed', 'unreachable', 'refused',
+        'objected', 'manual_recorded', 'failed', 'completed'
+      ) THEN NULL
+      ELSE next_attempt_at
+    END

+- `insert_reference_call` deliberately takes no `next_attempt_at` param — creation always stamps `now()` (FR-RC3); re-enable after skip is a later story's guarded update.
detail: The CASE only clears or preserves next_attempt_at; after a skip it is NULL, so re-enable via this guarded update leaves a queued row with no clock. The only clock-setting query (append) also bumps attempt_count and records a phantom attempt.
recommended_fix: Ship a dedicated re-enable guarded update that stamps next_attempt_at = now() (or takes a timestamp), and call this out in the RC2.3 handoff so re-enable does not reuse update_reference_call_status.

title: get_reference_call_by_form_token and list_reference_calls_for_application ship with zero test coverage
detail: These eight are every test in the file (all 306 lines read); none exercises get_reference_call_by_form_token or list_reference_calls_for_application, both shipped in this diff.
recommended_fix: Add integration tests: token lookup returns the row and an unknown token returns none; list returns the application's calls in created_at, id order.
